instruction: Convert all text in the document to uppercase.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent selected all text (Ctrl+A) and used Format > Text > Capitalize Every Word to convert first letter of each word to uppercase. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select all text, navigate Format menu, apply text case transformations in LibreOffice Writer
metadata.task_rationale: Original task used Capitalize Every Word; this variation tests the related UPPERCASE text case transformation via the same Format > Text menu
metadata.explanation: Task requires converting all document text to uppercase. Getter extracts all text, metric checks that 95%+ of alphabetic characters are uppercase.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all paragraph text from the docx file using python-docx, which is the right state for verifying uppercase conversion
Metric correctly counts the ratio of uppercase alphabetic characters and applies a reasonable 95% threshold with partial credit at 80%
Metric does not use the 'expected' parameter, which is fine since the uppercase check is self-contained (no expected value needed)
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads it, ensuring the latest state is persisted
Instruction has a single requirement (convert to uppercase) and the evaluator fully covers it
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter only reads doc.paragraphs, missing text in tables, headers, footers, or text boxes. For most documents this is sufficient, but for documents with tables it could miss content.
